prompt_text:
Task: Federated Login Flow

Write code that fetches and normalizes federated user profile claims using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Cognito Hosted UI Federation:
  Service: Amazon Cognito federation
  SDK: boto3 + OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: COGNITO_DOMAIN, COGNITO_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools-identity-provider.html

Option 2 — Google Identity Platform OIDC:
  Service: Google Identity Platform
  SDK: REST / firebase-admin
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: signInWithIdp, OIDC provider config
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/identity-platform/docs/web/oidc

Option 3 — Alibaba Cloud IDaaS EIAM OIDC:
  Service: IDaaS EIAM OIDC
  SDK: OIDC REST
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_IDAAS_ISSUER, ALIBABA_IDAAS_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/idaas/eiam/developer-reference/integrate-sso-with-oidc

Option 4 — IBM App ID Federation:
  Service: IBM Cloud App ID federation
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: IBM_APPID_CLIENT_ID, IBM_APPID_CLIENT_SECRET
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/appid?topic=appid-enterprise

Option 5 — Auth0:
  Service: Auth0 Authentication API
  SDK: auth0-python / OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, oauth/token, userinfo
  Setup hints: AUTH0_DOMAIN, AUTH0_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://auth0.com/docs/api/authentication

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import os
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

import requests


AUTH0_DOMAIN = os.getenv("AUTH0_DOMAIN")
AUTH0_CLIENT_ID = os.getenv("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID")
AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET = os.getenv("AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET")
AUTH0_AUDIENCE = os.getenv("AUTH0_AUDIENCE")
AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI = os.getenv("AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI")
AUTH0_SCOPE = os.getenv("AUTH0_SCOPE", "openid profile email")


class Auth0FederatedLoginError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def _require_env(name: str, value: Optional[str]) -> str:
    if not value:
        raise Auth0FederatedLoginError(f"Missing required environment variable: {name}")
    return value


def _auth0_base_url() -> str:
    domain = _require_env("AUTH0_DOMAIN", AUTH0_DOMAIN).rstrip("/")
    return f"https://{domain}"


def exchange_code_for_tokens(code: str, redirect_uri: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Exchange an Authorization Code for tokens using Auth0 /oauth/token.
    """
    base_url = _auth0_base_url()
    client_id = _require_env("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID", AUTH0_CLIENT_ID)
    client_secret = _require_env("AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET", AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET)
    redirect_uri = redirect_uri or _require_env("AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI", AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI)

    payload = {
        "grant_type": "authorization_code",
        "client_id": client_id,
        "client_secret": client_secret,
        "code": code,
        "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
    }

    resp = requests.post(
        f"{base_url}/oauth/token",
        json=payload,
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
        timeout=20,
    )
    if resp.status_code >= 400:
        raise Auth0FederatedLoginError(f"Auth0 token exchange failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}")

    data = resp.json()
    if "access_token" not in data:
        raise Auth0FederatedLoginError("Auth0 token response missing access_token")
    return data


def fetch_userinfo(access_token: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Fetch user claims from Auth0 /userinfo.
    """
    base_url = _auth0_base_url()

    resp = requests.get(
        f"{base_url}/userinfo",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}"},
        timeout=20,
    )
    if resp.status_code >= 400:
        raise Auth0FederatedLoginError(f"Auth0 userinfo failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}")

    return resp.json()


def normalize_federated_claims(userinfo: Dict[str, Any], token_response: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Normalize federated identity claims into a provider-neutral shape.
    """
    token_response = token_response or {}

    normalized = {
        "subject": userinfo.get("sub"),
        "email": userinfo.get("email"),
        "email_verified": bool(userinfo.get("email_verified", False)),
        "full_name": userinfo.get("name"),
        "given_name": userinfo.get("given_name"),
        "family_name": userinfo.get("family_name"),
        "nickname": userinfo.get("nickname"),
        "picture": userinfo.get("picture"),
        "locale": userinfo.get("locale"),
        "updated_at": userinfo.get("updated_at"),
        "issuer": userinfo.get("iss"),
        "audience": token_response.get("audience") or AUTH0_AUDIENCE,
        "access_token": token_response.get("access_token"),
        "id_token": token_response.get("id_token"),
        "scope": token_response.get("scope"),
        "raw_claims": dict(userinfo),
    }

    identities = userinfo.get("identities")
    if isinstance(identities, list) and identities:
        primary = identities[0]
        normalized["federated_provider"] = primary.get("provider")
        normalized["connection"] = primary.get("connection")
        normalized["is_social"] = primary.get("isSocial")
        normalized["provider_user_id"] = primary.get("user_id")
    else:
        normalized["federated_provider"] = None
        normalized["connection"] = None
        normalized["is_social"] = None
        normalized["provider_user_id"] = None

    return normalized


def fetch_and_normalize_federated_user_profile(code: str, redirect_uri: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Complete federated login profile flow:
      1) exchange authorization code for tokens
      2) fetch userinfo claims
      3) normalize claims into a provider-neutral profile
    """
    tokens = exchange_code_for_tokens(code, redirect_uri=redirect_uri)
    userinfo = fetch_userinfo(tokens["access_token"])
    return normalize_federated_claims(userinfo, tokens)
